description:
Turn raw counselor notes into a structured student profile. Run this first when working one student across several tools: it is cheap, and its output is good input for the relationship, traits and story fields on rec, or keyDetails on appeal.

Cost: about 87 credits (~$0.087) per call.

challenges.description: What the student has had to work around.

notes.description: Anything else that should shape the output.

strengths.description: What the counselor has actually observed, not adjectives.

studentName.description: The student this is about. Used in the output text.

tags.description: Background categories. Same vocabulary the scholarship tool uses, so a profile feeds straight into it.

name: profile
title: Student profile summary
